name: Spectral Radius Bipartiteness
description: Replaced the seed's 2x2 matrix with a 3x3 matrix whose largest eigenvalue evaluates to sqrt(x^2+y^2). Requiring this to be exactly sqrt(5) forces x and y to be 1 and 2 in some order, preserving the exact bipartiteness constraint while breaking memorized associations with the specific 2x2 matrix in the seed.
